package rulefixtures

// scenario for gorm_model_contains_calculated_response_fields: Persistence structs that carry API-only derived presentation fields.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Rule062PositiveRecord struct {
	ID        int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	FirstName string `gorm:"column:first_name;size:100"`
	LastName  string `gorm:"column:last_name;size:100"`
	FullName  string `gorm:"-"`
}

func (r *Rule062PositiveRecord) AfterFind(tx *gorm.DB) error {
	r.FullName = r.FirstName + " " + r.LastName
	return nil
}
